palette.name: Swiss High-Contrast
palette.description: Objective, rigid, functional. 95% monochrome with signal colors for action.

buttons.primary: rounded-md bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 h-10 px-4 py-2
buttons.secondary: rounded-md bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 h-10 px-4 py-2
buttons.ghost: rounded-md hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground h-10 px-4 py-2
buttons.outline: rounded-md border border-input bg-background hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground h-10 px-4 py-2

kanban.column: flex-shrink-0 w-80 flex flex-col gap-4 bg-zinc-50/50 dark:bg-zinc-900/50 p-4 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200/50 dark:border-zinc-800/50 h-full

universal_guidelines: Do not use generic centered layouts. Use grids and asymmetry.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover, focus, active).
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
Do not use 'transition: all'. Animate specific properties.
Use Shadcn components from src/components/ui but customize them via className.
For charts, use Recharts with the defined color palette.
Ensure high contrast for text (WCAG AA minimum).
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the Job Tracker Dashboard using the Swiss Design principles. Focus on the Kanban board as the central feature. Use the provided logo URLs for the mock data in the application cards. Ensure the layout is responsive and uses the defined spacing scale. The dashboard should feel 'objective' and 'precise' - avoid unnecessary decoration.
